product_metadata.title: AYRELY Battery Operated Cordless Digital Alarm Clock with Date,Temperature,Smart Sensor Light,12/24Hr,Snooze for Bedrooms,Office,Heavy Sleepers,Kids(White)
features: 【Large Display Digital Clock】Multifunctional large digital numbers is to display time (12/24hr), temperature (°C or °F)，date and alarming time. They are shown clearly and comfortable for eyes. Big bold numbers is friendly to kids and the elderly. Concise style makes it a good decoration for your home or office.

【Ascending Alarm and Big Snooze Button】It raises the alarm gradually to awake users gently. The alarm goes off with a gradual beep for 60 seconds, then it stops itself. The SNOOZE button on the top is big and easy to find. Press the SNOOZE button, the alarm will pause for 5 minutes and then sound again.

【Smart sensor Light Activated at Night】Turn on sensor switch, the clock will automatically give off soft blue light in darkness. Or press SNOOZE/LIGHT button, it will light up the background for 5 seconds.
【Battery Operated Alarm Clock】Since it is battery powered you can put it wherever you want to. It is powered by 3*AAA carbon batteries (not included).
